name: discord
description: Shows in your Discord profile what you are listening to, with cover, progress and a button to listen along. Your friends on Discord see it.

display.label: Name in the member list
display.description: What your friends see next to your name, after "Listening to".

progress.label: Show how far the track is

links.label: Title and artist open YouTube Music
links.description: Clicking the title opens the track, clicking the artist searches for them.

icon.label: Small icon on the cover
icon.description: The app's icon; hovering it shows whether you like the track.

appButton.label: Button "Get the app"
appButton.description: Leads to this app's page on GitHub.

options.label: Keep the track, marked as paused
